entries.zh: 电子像一团紧贴原子核的球形雾，在距核约 1 个玻尔半径处出现概率最大，没有任何择优方向。
entries.en: The electron is a spherical haze hugging the nucleus, most likely found about 1 Bohr radius from it, with no preferred direction.

entries.zh: 比 1s 更大的球形雾，内部包着一层“空心”球壳（径向节面）；电子既可能出现在离核很近处，也可能出现在远处。
entries.en: A larger spherical haze than 1s, with a hollow shell (a radial node) inside; the electron may be very near the nucleus or far away.

entries.zh: 哑铃形的两叶概率云，两叶之间穿过原子核的平面是角向节面，电子只出现在节面两侧的两叶中。
entries.en: A dumbbell-shaped cloud of two lobes. The plane through the nucleus between the lobes is the angular node; the electron appears only in the two lobes on either side of it.

entries.zh: 更加弥散的球形云，含有两个同心的“空心”球壳（两个径向节面），一共三层球壳结构。
entries.en: An even more diffuse spherical cloud with two concentric hollow shells (two radial nodes), three layers in all.

entries.zh: 哑铃形两叶云内部又多出一个径向节面，整体比 2p 更舒展，电子可以离核更远。
entries.en: A two-lobed dumbbell cloud with an extra radial node inside; more spread out than 2p, so the electron can be farther from the nucleus.

entries.zh: 形状复杂的多叶概率云（dxy 等为四叶花瓣形，dz² 为双叶加赤道环），空间方向性最强。
entries.en: Complex multi-lobed clouds (dxy and similar are four-petal shapes, dz² is two lobes plus an equatorial ring) with the strongest directionality.

entries.zh: m = +1 与 −1 的实轨道组合
m = +2 与 −2 的实轨道组合
电子沿半径为 n²a₀ 的确定圆轨道运动；降低能级时螺旋落向内层并放出一个能量确定的光子（叮咚声为示意）。
entries.en: The electron moves on a fixed circular orbit of radius n²a₀. Dropping to a lower level, it spirals inward and releases one photon of fixed energy (the chime is only illustrative).

entries.zh: 玻尔模型：电子在确定的圆形轨道上绕核运动，跃迁时吸收或发射能量确定的光子。
entries.en: Bohr model: the electron circles the nucleus on a fixed orbit and absorbs or emits photons of fixed energy when it jumps.

entries.zh: 电子云模型：波函数只给出电子在各处出现的概率，点越密概率越大，不存在确定轨道。
entries.en: Electron cloud model: the wave function only gives the probability of finding the electron; the denser the dots, the higher the probability. There are no fixed orbits.

entries.zh: 玻尔模型中电子沿确定的轨道运动；量子力学中不存在轨道，只有概率分布（电子云）。
entries.en: In the Bohr model the electron follows a fixed orbit; in quantum mechanics there are no orbits, only a probability distribution (the electron cloud).

entries.zh: 玻尔模型 × 量子电子云
玻尔模型 · 能级 n
同时叠加显示全部允许轨道（n=1…6）
entries.en: Show all allowed orbits at once (n=1…6)

entries.zh: 向更低能级切换时，电子将螺旋跃迁并发出一个光子。
entries.en: Switching to a lower level makes the electron spiral down and emit a photon.

entries.en: Sampled from the real wave function |ψ|² = |R

entries.zh: 径向概率密度 P(r) = r²|R(r)|²
虚线标出概率峰对应的最概然半径（以玻尔半径 a₀ 为单位）。
entries.en: The dashed line marks the most probable radius at the probability peak (in Bohr radii a₀).
